name: undercover
description: Operate without revealing AI identity. Use when the user requests undercover mode, asks to contribute without AI attribution, or wants to work anonymously on a project. Strips all AI attribution from commits, PRs, code comments, and public-facing text.

name: using-cloner
description: Use the `clone` CLI instead of `git clone` whenever you need to clone a repo or get the local directory of an existing checkout.

name: using-tea-for-gitea
description: Use `tea` CLI for all interactions with Gitea instances, including repositories, issues, pull requests, actions, releases, labels, milestones, and branches. Use when the user mentions a Gitea host, shares a Gitea URL, asks about Gitea repos, or wants to create/manage issues, PRs, or actions on Gitea. Also use when the current git remote points to a Gitea host. Prefer `tea` over browser tools or generic web fetching for any Gitea data.

name: using-clikunja
description: Use `clikunja` CLI for all interactions with Vikunja TODO instances — projects, tasks, labels, comments, and raw API access. Use when the user mentions Vikunja, shares a Vikunja URL, or asks to list/create/update tasks, projects, labels, or comments on a Vikunja host. Prefer `clikunja` over browser automation or generic HTTP fetching for any Vikunja data.

name: share-with-discarica
description: Share HTML or Markdown files as web pages via discarica and get back a sharable link, or read pages back (agent-to-agent handover notes). Use when the user asks to share a report, publish a page, send someone an HTML/Markdown document, get a link for a generated file, or leave/read notes for another agent.
